name: NVR
description: NVR builds single-family homes, townhomes and condominiums under the Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes names in 37 metro areas in 16 states and Washington, D.C. Unlike most builders it does not own or develop land: it buys finished lots from third-party developers under fixed-price lot purchase agreements, paying deposits (up to about 10 percent of the price) that it forfeits if it walks away, and builds homes mostly after the buyer has signed. Because it carries little land, it needs little capital and spends its cash on buying back stock; shares outstanding fell to about 2.9M (basic weighted average 2,900K in 2025 vs 3,238K in 2023), and the share price is in the thousands of dollars. A small mortgage banking arm originates loans for its buyers and sells them within about 30 days.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recorded from general knowledge of the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source. SEC SIC code is 1531 (Operative Builders) per EDGAR. Mowgli classification is not set here.

hq.note: 11700 Plaza America Dr., Suite 500, Reston, VA 20190 (EDGAR business address); Virginia corporation

employees.note: Approximately 6,300 full-time (about 5,320 homebuilding, about 980 mortgage banking); about 7,000 a year earlier. FY2025 10-K

businessLines.name: Homebuilding
businessLines.how: Homebuyers pay the full price at settlement (one-time; average $460,600 per home in 2025), most pre-sold; NVR profit is price minus the fixed price of the finished lot it optioned, construction and selling costs. It puts up lot deposits rather than buying and developing land, so returns on capital are high and cash goes to buybacks.
businessLines.description: Ryan Homes (first-time and first-time move-up), NVHomes and Heartland Homes (move-up and luxury); four regional reporting segments: Mid Atlantic, North East, Mid East, South East.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $1,960.6M; FY2023 $1,795.6M. Share is of income before taxes of $1,761.9M. Gross margin 21.2% in 2025 vs 23.7% in 2024.

businessLines.name: Mortgage Banking
businessLines.how: Earns fees and gains on selling each loan to investors, plus title and closing fees, on loans made to NVR's own homebuyers; no long-term loan holding, so income follows settlements and rates.
businessLines.description: NVR Mortgage Finance originates mortgage loans for NVR home buyers and sells them into the secondary market, usually within 30 days; also title insurance and closing services.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $154.9M. Margin is on fees only.

brands.name: Ryan Homes
brands.note: First-time and first-time move-up buyers; all 37 metro areas. Unit counts by brand not disclosed in the 10-K excerpts read.

brands.name: NVHomes
brands.note: Move-up and luxury; Delaware, New Jersey, Washington D.C., Baltimore and Philadelphia metros
